swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: TLV9062IDR is limited to 5.5 V max (6 V abs max, p.10) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 4.5x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs TLV9062IDR: 10 MHz p.13); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.5x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs TLV9062IDR: 6.5 V/µs p.13); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 160000x (MC33202DR2G: 80000 pA p.3 vs TLV9062IDR: 0.5 pA p.13); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TLV9062IDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (6 V, p.10) than MC33202DR2G (13 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs TLV9062IDR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 125°C)); MC33202DR2G hot limit only 105 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and TLV9062IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; GBWP differs 4.5x; slew rate differs 6.5x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 10 MHz (p.13), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 5.5 V (p.10), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 1.6 mV (p.13), Ib 160000x gap (80000 vs 0.5 pA), voltage noise 20 vs 16 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and TLV9062IDR "6.0 V Absolute Maximum Supply Limit — Destructive in 12 V / 24 V LM358 or TL072 SOIC-8 Sockets" (p.10). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when supply rails exceed 5.5 V (rated up to 12 V); choose TLV9062IDR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 10 MHz GBWP or DC precision demands <= 1.6 mV max Vos. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.6) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
